identityProvider.title: Identity providers
identityProvider.description: Let people sign in with their company account (Google Workspace, Azure AD or any OIDC service). The email domain decides which connection is used.
identityProvider.callbackUrl: Redirect URI to register with the identity provider

hint.name: Shown on the sign-in button, e.g. “Acme Azure AD”.
hint.issuer: OIDC issuer URL; endpoints are read from /.well-known/openid-configuration.
hint.clientSecret: Write-only: it is never shown again after saving.
hint.clientSecretKeep: Leave empty to keep the current secret.
hint.domains: People with these email domains see this connection after entering their email. A domain can belong to only one connection.

policy.autoCreateHint: Accounts are only created for the domains registered above.

remove.title: Delete identity provider
remove.confirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Its domains are released and linked people can no longer sign in with it.

identityProvider.notAllowed: The platform administrator has turned off external IdPs for this tenant: connections can't be added or enabled, and sign-in doesn't redirect to an external IdP.
